Question: What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    a.Agent_Identifier AS Agent_ID,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(pr.Total_Reserve, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE COALESCE(lp.Total_Paid, 0) / COALESCE(pr.Total_Reserve, 0)
    END AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement ag
    ON ag.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Agent a
    ON a.Agent_Identifier = ag.Agent_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        c.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(cp.Amount) AS Total_Paid
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Payment cp
        ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY c.Policy_Identifier
) lp
    ON lp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        c.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(cr.Amount) AS Total_Reserve
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
        ON cr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY c.Policy_Identifier
) pr
    ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier;

What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid and the agent who sold it?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder_Name,
    p.Premium_Amount_Paid,
    a.Agent_Name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp.Amount END), 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr.Amount END), 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp.Amount END), 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr.Amount END), 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Policy p
    ON c.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Holder ph
    ON p.Policy_Holder_Identifier = ph.Policy_Holder_Identifier
JOIN Agent a
    ON p.Agent_Identifier = a.Agent_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cr.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder_Name,
    p.Premium_Amount_Paid,
    a.Agent_Name;

Question: What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid and the agent who sold it?
What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by catastrophe and policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(
        COALESCE(cp.Payment_Amount, 0) +
        COALESCE(cr.Reserve_Amount, 0)
    ) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = c.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
    ON cr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number;

Question: What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by catastrophe and policy number?
Return agents and the policy they have sold that have had a claim and the corresponding expense payment amount by agent id, policy number and claim number
Generated Query:
SELECT
    a.Agent_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Expense_Payment_Amount
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement ag
    ON ag.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Agent a
    ON a.Agent_Identifier = ag.Agent_Identifier
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Insurable_Object_Identifier = ag.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    a.Agent_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY
    a.Agent_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number;
